example_assumptions.transient: Illustrative constant component powers applied at time zero to a board initially at 25 C. Volumetric heat capacities are assumed scalar values, not measured for this board.
example_assumptions.component_temperatures: The saved board frames are spatial fields. Component case/junction values elsewhere in the result are steady estimates; no package transient storage is solved.
example_assumptions.scope: Approximate structured board stack with one depth cell per physical row, 3 mm lateral grid, no airflow, fin solids, or temperature-dependent properties.
